messages.content: Write a short note, about 50 words, to my class teacher saying I missed school yesterday because of a family wedding. I am Aarav from 7B.

Dear Ma'am,
I was absent from school yesterday because I attended my cousin's wedding with my family. I am sorry for missing class. I have already copied the notes from a friend, and I will finish the homework by tomorrow.
Thank you,
Aarav, Class 7B
I'm having a birthday party on Saturday at 5 pm at my house. Can you write an invitation message for my friends' group? Under 60 words, cheerful.

Hi everyone! I'm turning thirteen, and I'd love to celebrate with you. Come over to my house this Saturday at 5 pm for cake, games and lots of snacks. Wear something comfortable, because there will be dancing. Please reply by Thursday so I know how many samosas to order. See you there!
Help me write a diary entry of about 100 words about my grandmother visiting us after a long time.

Dear Diary,
Nani came to stay with us today after almost two years. The moment she walked in, the whole house smelled of the laddoos she had brought from her village. She looked a little smaller than I remembered, but her laugh was just as loud. After dinner, we sat on the terrace, and she told me stories about Ma as a naughty little girl. I laughed so much my stomach hurt. She is staying for three weeks, and I already know it will feel too short. Tomorrow she has promised to teach me her pickle recipe.
I missed a project deadline at work. Please write a short apology email to my manager, Mr. Iyer, around 80 words. My name is Kavya.

Subject: Delay in the project report
Dear Mr. Iyer,
I am sorry that I did not submit the project report by yesterday's deadline. I underestimated the time needed to check the figures, and I should have told you earlier. The report is now almost complete, and I will send it to you by 2 pm today. In future, I will share progress updates sooner so that delays do not come as a surprise.
Thank you for your patience.
Regards,
Kavya
Describe a rainy morning in 4 or 5 sentences. It's for my English class.

The rain began before sunrise, tapping softly on the tin roof above my window. By the time I woke up, the street outside was shining like a dark mirror. A row of crows sat on the electric wire, shaking water from their feathers. The air smelled of wet earth and someone's morning chai. Even the busy road seemed quieter, as if the whole town had decided to move a little slower.
Could you write a tiny story, around 100 words, about a lost tiffin box? It's for my six-year-old son.

Meera opened her school bag at lunchtime, but her red tiffin box was gone. Her tummy rumbled. She looked under her desk, behind the door and even inside the dustbin. No tiffin. Then she heard a giggle from the window. Outside, a little monkey sat on the wall, holding her red box and sniffing it. "That's mine!" said Meera. The monkey opened it, took one bite of her mother's spicy paratha and made a funny face. He put the box down and ran away. Meera laughed, picked it up and shared her lunch with her friends.
Our class magazine wants a paragraph on Onam. About 80 words, please.

Onam is the harvest festival of Kerala, celebrated with great joy by people of all backgrounds. Families decorate their front yards with pookalam, beautiful carpets of fresh flowers arranged in circles. The highlight is the Onam Sadya, a grand feast served on a banana leaf, with many dishes such as avial, sambar and payasam. In many places there are snake boat races, folk dances and songs. Above all, Onam is a time for coming together and sharing happiness.
Please draft a notice for our building residents about a cleanliness drive this Sunday at 8 am. Keep it to about 70 words.

NOTICE: Cleanliness Drive
All residents are invited to join a cleanliness drive this Sunday at 8 am. We will meet near the main gate and clean the stairs, the parking area and the garden together. Gloves and bags will be provided. Children are welcome with an adult. Please bring a water bottle and wear old clothes. Tea and biscuits will be served afterwards. Let's work together to keep our home clean and pleasant.
- Residents' Committee
My friend Daniel just won a district chess tournament. Write him a congratulations message in two or three sentences.

Congratulations, Daniel! Winning the district chess tournament is a huge achievement, and all those evenings of practice have clearly paid off. I'm so proud of you, and I can't wait to hear how you won the final game.
I need a postcard message to my grandparents from our trip to Goa. About 60 words.

Dear Dadi and Dadaji,
Greetings from Goa! The sea here is so blue, and the beaches are lined with coconut trees. Yesterday we visited an old white church and ate fresh fish curry for lunch. Riya collected a whole bag of shells for you. We miss your stories at bedtime, though. See you soon!
With love,
Kabir
My favourite teacher, Mrs. Fernandes, is retiring. Can you write a thank-you note from me, around 80 words?

Dear Mrs. Fernandes,
Thank you for everything you have taught me over the years. You made English my favourite subject, and you always made time to listen when I was worried about something. I still remember the day you read my story aloud to the class. It gave me the confidence to keep writing. I will miss seeing you in the corridor every morning. I wish you a happy, peaceful retirement full of good books and long walks.
With gratitude,
Sana
Our cat is missing. Write the text for a poster, under 50 words. She's grey with white paws and is called Biscuit.

MISSING CAT
Have you seen Biscuit?
She is a small grey cat with white paws and a pink collar. She is shy but gentle. She went missing on Tuesday evening near Lake Road.
If you see her, please call 98XXX XXXXX.
Thank you!
Write a paragraph for our school newsletter on why reading before bed is a good habit. About 70 words.

Reading before bed is one of the simplest habits a student can build. A few pages of a story help the mind slow down after a busy day of classes and homework. Unlike a bright screen, a book lets your eyes rest. Over time, nightly reading also builds vocabulary and imagination without feeling like study. Start with just ten minutes a night, and you may find it becomes the best part of your day.
Tomorrow is my first day at a new office, and the team wants each new person to introduce themselves in a short message. My name is Arjun and I'm joining as a junior designer. About 60 words.

Hello everyone! I'm Arjun, and I'm joining the team as a junior designer. I recently finished my design course, and I'm excited to learn from all of you. Outside work, I enjoy sketching street scenes and playing badminton on weekends. Please feel free to say hello if you see me looking lost near the coffee machine. I look forward to working with you.
Can you write a paragraph of about 80 words on why I enjoy my morning walk?

My morning walk is the quietest part of my day. I leave home just as the sky turns pale, when the streets are still empty. I pass the milk van, the old man feeding pigeons and the tea stall lighting its stove. Walking without my phone, I notice small things, like a new flower on a neighbour's wall. By the time I return, my mind feels clear and ready for the day. It is my favourite way to begin.
My younger brother has his board exams next week. Write a short message, about 40 words, wishing him luck.

Hey champ, all the best for your board exams! You have worked hard all year, so trust yourself. Sleep well, eat properly and read each question slowly. Whatever happens, I'm proud of you. Call me after the first paper.
Please write a 100-word story for children about a girl who finds a kite on her roof.

One windy afternoon, Zoya climbed up to the roof to collect the dry clothes. There, stuck between two water tanks, was a bright yellow kite with a long tail. Its string was torn. Zoya looked around, but nobody was calling for it. She carried it downstairs, tied a new string with her grandfather's help and drew a smiling sun on it. The next morning, a boy from the next building knocked on the door. "That's my kite," he said shyly. Zoya grinned. "Then let's fly it together." By evening, the two were the best of friends.
My roommate and I need to share the electricity bill. Write a polite note I can leave on the fridge, about 60 words.

Hi Priya,
The electricity bill for this month has arrived. The total is 1,840 rupees, so your share is 920. I have paid it already, so you can transfer your half to me whenever it suits you this week. The bill is on the table if you want to check it.
Thanks, and have a good day!
Megha
I forgot my best friend's birthday yesterday. Write a sorry message for her, around 50 words, sincere but not too dramatic.

Hi Tara, I'm really sorry I missed your birthday yesterday. There's no good excuse, and I feel bad about it. You matter a lot to me. Can I make it up to you with ice cream and a long chat this weekend? My treat. Happy belated birthday!
For descriptive writing class, describe a busy market in the evening in about 100 words.

By six in the evening, the market wakes up. Strings of yellow bulbs flicker on above the stalls, and the smell of frying pakoras drifts through the air. Vegetable sellers call out their prices over the honking of scooters squeezing through the narrow lane. A woman bargains firmly over a pile of shining brinjals, while her small son tugs at her sari, pointing at a balloon seller. Bangles clink at one stall, and pressure cookers stand stacked like towers at another. Everyone seems to be in a hurry, yet nobody really wants to leave.
